comments.author: home
comments.text: Starting work on supporting the Omarchy 'hackerman' theme. Following outside-in BDD: will write feature specifications in features/themes.feature, implement theme support in markusmd (CSS variables, API, CLI, front matter), verify with behave and ruff, and close.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Completed implementation of the hackerman theme:
- Added `themes.py` with theme registry and validation.
- Added standalone `static/themes/hackerman.css` and bundled theme definitions into `static/markus.css`.
- Updated `render.py` to support `data-theme` attribute on html, body, and article nodes.
- Updated `api.py` and `cli.py` to support `theme` argument in `convert()` / `render()` and `--theme` in `markus convert`.
- Supported theme declaration in document YAML front matter.
- Updated `sitebuild.py` to copy static themes and support page front-matter themes.
- Added comprehensive BDD feature tests in `features/themes.feature` and updated `features/site.feature`.
- Verified all 48 scenarios in behave test suite pass and ruff lint passes.
